tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Returns one Solidmade offer by id (from list_services): what it includes, price, how to start and its page on solidmade.co.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends Solidmade a job request on the user's behalf. Only call it after the user agrees to share their email and site link. Solidmade replies to that email from hello@solidmade.co within one business day with one fixed price and a date; nothing starts and nothing is charged until the user agrees.
